resourceProfile.assessment: The complete English and Simplified Chinese source scope, review metadata, glossary, and project concept references were available locally.

automatedQuality.summary: Translation review metadata, queue validation, typecheck, 79 test files with 462 tests, complete build, 39 IIS rules with 61 route cases, and 724 generated-link checks passed.

linguisticCritique.summary: A bounded Simplified Chinese pass identified 25 actionable technical translation defects; all 25 were corrected.

competentHumanReview.summary: No competent Simplified Chinese human review was performed in this cycle; changed IDs remain machine-drafted.

publicationAuthorization.summary: No merge, publication, deployment, or residual-risk authorization was requested or granted.

findings.summary: The current formula used a Chinese character for the variable I.
evidence: The equation must solve for current I.

findings.summary: The title translated current as a context-dependent word for present or current time.
evidence: The example calculates electrical current.
findings.resolution: Changed the title to the standard Chinese term for current.

findings.summary: The formula omitted unit spacing and the ohm symbol.
evidence: The result is 4.2 A from 4.2 V and 1.0 Ω.

findings.summary: The resistance title used an unnatural literal translation.
evidence: The example calculates resistance.
findings.resolution: Changed the title to the standard Chinese technical term.

findings.summary: The resistance formula omitted unit spacing.
evidence: The result is 6 Ω from 12 V and 2 A.

findings.summary: The voltage example used VCC instead of the variable V.
evidence: The example solves for voltage V.

findings.summary: The title said electrical force or electricity rather than electrical power.
evidence: The section defines P and reports watts.
findings.resolution: Changed the title to electrical power.

findings.summary: The megohm conversion was mistranslated as a million euros.
evidence: The source defines 1 MΩ = 1,000,000 Ω.

findings.summary: The milliampere conversion used prose and omitted the standard unit symbols.
evidence: The source defines 1 mA = 0.001 A.
findings.resolution: Restored the standard mA and A symbols.

findings.summary: The conclusion expressed power as joules per second without clearly separating energy and power.
evidence: The calculation gives 7.2 W and 72 J over 10 seconds.
findings.resolution: Separated power in watts from total energy in joules.

findings.summary: The branch definition used a current-path phrase that was not natural Chinese.
evidence: A branch is a path between two nodes.
findings.resolution: Rewrote it as an electrical current path.

findings.summary: The KCL example rendered 8 A as eight units of A and called current direction current time.
evidence: The example uses 8 A entering, 3 A leaving, and 5 A remaining.
findings.resolution: Corrected the quantities and current-direction wording.

findings.summary: The total-current variable was localized inside the equation.
evidence: The formula must retain I_total.

findings.summary: The total-resistance variable was localized inside the equation.
evidence: The formula must retain R_total.

findings.summary: The parallel-current equation used a localized total-current variable.
evidence: The formula must retain I_total.

findings.summary: The reciprocal resistance equation used a localized total-resistance variable.
evidence: The formula must retain R_total.

findings.summary: The parallel example used an inconsistent localized current variable.
evidence: The example calculates total current from 4.0 V and 0.20 Ω.

findings.summary: Voltage equations omitted spacing and mixed Chinese prose into symbolic labels.
evidence: The equations are shared technical notation across locales.
findings.resolution: Restored spacing and the stable parallel-branches label.

findings.summary: Series and parallel labels in the cell equations were literal and inconsistent.
evidence: The formulas distinguish series voltage from parallel capacity.
findings.resolution: Restored the standard series and parallel labels.

findings.summary: The heat-flux example wrote units as Chinese words inside the equation.
evidence: The result is 5,000 W/m² from 100 W over 0.020 m².
findings.resolution: Restored the standard unit symbols and superscripts.

findings.summary: The length base-unit row translated metre as an instrument and used a Chinese word instead of m.
evidence: The SI length unit is metre, symbol m.

findings.summary: The mass row used incorrect Chinese wording and mismatched the unit and symbol.
evidence: The SI mass unit is kilogram, symbol kg.
findings.resolution: Corrected the row to 质量、千克、kg.

findings.summary: The electric-current symbol was translated as a Chinese word instead of A.
evidence: The SI current unit is ampere, symbol A.

findings.summary: The amount-of-substance row used a mistranslated word for mole and the wrong symbol.
evidence: The SI unit is mole, symbol mol.

findings.summary: The candela symbol was mistranslated as a compact disc.
evidence: The SI symbol for candela is cd.
